Chapter 629: Chapter 45: Great Harvest (5200 Words, Please Subscribe)

Chapter 629: Chapter 45: Great Harvest (5200 words, please subscribe)

In some sense, the “Mysterious Yellow Strike” resembles more of a “passive” secret technique.

Of course, activating the “Mysterious Yellow Strike” requires a great deal of energy, but energy consumption is the least of Lin Yuan’s worries now.

Such a vast inner world, both in terms of sheer size and spatial depth, is unknowable how many times larger compared to a typical Ninth Rank.

“If the ‘Mysterious Yellow Strike’ is layered with the Divine Skill ‘Enhancement,’ my potential for sudden explosive attacks…” Lin Yuan’s heart raced.

So far, Lin Yuan’s defensive strategies had far surpassed his offensive techniques, as after all, the Divine Skill ‘Enhancement’ couldn’t be used casually.

With the ‘Mysterious Yellow Strike,’ he could significantly improve his offensive capabilities.

...

As for the defensive secret technique “Primordial Yellow Physique,” it’s also a body refining method.

Sturdy as Primordial Yellow, unyielding and immortal.

This secret technique is divided into four stages.

Once cultivated to perfection,

the physical body’s vitality spans millions of light-years; even for a supreme existence, it would be extremely difficult to destroy it.

Lin Yuan remembered that among the secret techniques left by the Master of the Demonic Jade Tower, there was one called “Demonic Jade Immortal Body,” which was also an extremely terrifying body refining method.

It just wasn’t clear how it compared to the “Primordial Yellow Physique” in terms of strength.

“Excellent.”

Lin Yuan was overjoyed.

Although he was protected by two major Physical Body Divine Abilities and had the Origin Clock safeguarding his physical soul and spirit,

the Blood Rebirth merely heightened the power of rebirth, not increasing the physical body’s strength, and the Elemental Body merely provided exemptions, similarly not augmenting the physical body’s strength.

The liquid in the Mysterious Gourd indeed increased the physical body’s strength, but that was not a secret technique.

The most important aspect was that secret techniques were universal; both the Primordial Spirit and the original body could cultivate them.

Like the Origin Clock, which could only be a trump card for the original body, Lin Yuan was reluctant to entrust the Primordial Spirit with the Origin Clock.

The death of the Primordial Spirit was of no concern to Lin Yuan, but the loss of the Origin Clock would be deeply distressing.

“Remember, there’s nothing specific to avoid with the ‘Mysterious Yellow Strike’ and ‘Primordial Yellow Physique.’ Cultivate them according to your circumstances, but for ‘Steps of Time and Space,’ even if you master it, you must use it with caution,” said the Six-Armed Silhouette suddenly.

“‘Steps of Time and Space’?”

Lin Yuan looked solemn as his mind was instantly flooded with information about this secret technique.

It was an escape technique, the most remarkable aspect being that it was a secret technique formed by combining the Rule of Time and the Space Rules.

The Rule of Time and Space Rules are two major pillar rules, especially the Rule of Time, which is profound and obscure, not to mention creating a secret technique based on both rules.

“‘Steps of Time and Space’ allows you to traverse vast spaces in an instant, but you must remember, you can only take a maximum of nine steps, even a Supreme Being can only take nine steps,” stated the Six-Armed Silhouette gravely.

“Even a Supreme Being can only take nine steps?”

Lin Yuan took note.

If the “Mysterious Yellow Strike” consumes energy on a ‘quantitative’ basis, then ‘Steps of Time and Space’ consumes it on a ‘proportional’ basis.

No matter the level of strength, activating this secret technique to take a single step would consume one-ninth of all of one’s power, including vitality, soul, and spirit.

Taking nine consecutive steps would bring one to a completely depleted state.

If one were to take another step at that time, it would cause irreversible damage to oneself.

Of course,

the cost is hefty.

But the effect is also dramatic.

With Lin Yuan’s current level of strength and realm, activating “Steps of Time and Space” allowed each step to cover millions of light-years.

Millions of light-years.

In a single step?

It is known that even with the effort of the Great Transference Skill, Lin Yuan could only traverse a few thousand light-years in one step.

Millions of light-years?

Lin Yuan would have to take a continuous thousand steps.

Even if one step was one breath, a thousand steps would still take a thousand breaths.

With this secret technique, even if facing an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse, as long as Lin Yuan hadn’t completed the nine steps, the opponent wouldn’t be able to catch up.

Once Lin Yuan completed the nine steps, he would likely have reached a safe location already, for one step covers millions of light-years, and nine steps equate to tens of millions of light-years.

Even in the vast Cosmic Starry Sky, tens of millions of light-years represent a significant distance.

“If a Supreme Being were to use this secret technique, a random step could land them anywhere in the cosmos,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The stronger the force, the higher the realm, the greater the distance each step covers in executing this secret technique. While Lin Yuan could travel millions of light-years in one step, a Supreme Being could probably cover half the universe in one step.

Even the farthest places are but two steps away.

However, for a Supreme Being, losing one-ninth or two-ninths of their strength is no small amount.

“You have now received all of His Majesty’s heritage,” the Six-Armed Silhouette looking at Lin Yuan, “Next, there is one more thing you need to do.”

“What is it?” Lin Yuan immediately asked.

“Make a vow,” said the Six-Armed Silhouette, “You may discretionally spread the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path, but the three secret techniques left by His Majesty are the protective laws of the Mysterious Emperor lineage and must absolutely not be disclosed to outsiders except His Majesty’s successors.”

The three major secret techniques, offensive, defensive, and escape, once widely known, could be used to target their weaknesses.

There is no perfect secret technique, like “Steps of Time and Space,” which seems invincible, but its flaw is also obvious, allowing only nine steps.

After the nine steps, one would fall into absolute weakness.

This fact, although not detrimental if unknown to enemies, what if they do learn of it and specifically wait until you’ve taken your nine steps to then pursue and catch you?

“Mysterious Yellow Strike” and “Primordial Yellow Physique” also have weaknesses, just not as significant as the “Steps of Time and Space,” thus they absolutely must not be disclosed.

This isn’t just an issue for Lin Yuan, a Mysterious Emperor’s successor, but also for the successors of other cosmic Mysterious Emperors.
